facebookresearch_fid/src/data.py.use_Collator_for_batching: use the Collator class to tokenize and batch QA examples with target answers
facebookresearch_fid/src/data.py.load_data_from_json: load data from a JSON or JSONL file with optional distributed shard splitting
facebookresearch_fid/src/data.py.encode_passages_with_tokenizer: encode a batch of text passages into token IDs and attention masks
facebookresearch_fid/src/data.py.use_RetrieverCollator_for_retrieval: use the RetrieverCollator to tokenize questions and passages with retrieval scores

facebookresearch_fid/src/evaluation.py.calculate_matches: calculate answer matches across retrieved documents using multiprocessing for QA evaluation
facebookresearch_fid/src/evaluation.py.has_answer: check if a document text contains any of the provided answer strings
facebookresearch_fid/src/evaluation.py.SimpleTokenizer_tokenize: tokenize text into alphanumeric tokens using unicode-aware regex pattern matching
facebookresearch_fid/src/evaluation.py.exact_match_score: compute exact match score between a prediction and ground truth answer
facebookresearch_fid/src/evaluation.py.eval_batch: evaluate a batch of retrieval scores by counting inversions and computing top-k metrics

facebookresearch_fid/src/index.py.create_faiss_indexer: create an Indexer with a flat inner product index for a given vector size
facebookresearch_fid/src/index.py.create_pq_indexer: create an Indexer using Product Quantization with subquantizers and bit width for compressed indexing
facebookresearch_fid/src/index.py.index_embeddings: index a batch of document embeddings with their corresponding database IDs into the FAISS index
facebookresearch_fid/src/index.py.search_knn_vectors: search the FAISS index with query vectors to retrieve top-k nearest neighbor document IDs and scores
facebookresearch_fid/src/index.py.serialize_index: serialize the FAISS index and its ID mapping metadata to disk for later reuse

facebookresearch_fid/src/model.py.build_FiDT5_model: build a Fusion-in-Decoder T5 model by instantiating FiDT5 with a T5 config
facebookresearch_fid/src/model.py.generate_FiDT5_outputs: generate text from a FiDT5 model using batched multi-passage input IDs and attention masks
facebookresearch_fid/src/model.py.extract_crossattention_scores: extract cross-attention scores from a FiDT5 decoder to compute passage similarity for a retriever
facebookresearch_fid/src/model.py.load_T5_weights_into_FiDT5: load pretrained T5 weights into a FiDT5 model using the load_t5 method with a state dict
facebookresearch_fid/src/model.py.build_Retriever_model: build a BERT-based retriever model that computes similarity scores between questions and passages

facebookresearch_fid/src/options.py.build_argparse_options_parser: build an argparse parser with basic experiment parameters like name, checkpoint_dir, and model_path
facebookresearch_fid/src/options.py.create_reader_options: create command-line arguments for a reader model including train_data, eval_data, and text_maxlength
facebookresearch_fid/src/options.py.create_retriever_options: create command-line arguments for a retriever model including indexing_dimension, question_maxlength, and passage_maxlength
facebookresearch_fid/src/options.py.create_optim_options: create command-line arguments for optimizer settings including learning rate, dropout, weight_decay, and scheduler
facebookresearch_fid/src/options.py.parse_options_with_get_options: parse CLI arguments using get_options with optional reader, retriever, optim, and eval flags

facebookresearch_fid/src/preprocess.py.run_preprocess_datasets: run the python module to preprocess NQ and TQA datasets from input directory to save directory
facebookresearch_fid/src/preprocess.py.select_examples_TQA: create a function that selects and formats TriviaQA examples with associated passage contexts
facebookresearch_fid/src/preprocess.py.select_examples_NQ: create a function that selects and formats Natural Questions examples with associated passage contexts
facebookresearch_fid/src/preprocess.py.refactor_select_examples_TQA: refactor the python select_examples_TQA function to support additional answer normalization strategies
facebookresearch_fid/src/preprocess.py.review_preprocess_main: review the python module main block that loads NQ and TQA data and saves preprocessed JSON

facebookresearch_fid/src/slurm.py.init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode for SLURM multi-GPU or single GPU jobs using params object
facebookresearch_fid/src/slurm.py.init_signal_handler: install SLURM signal handlers to handle job pre-emption and time limit SIGUSR1 signals
facebookresearch_fid/src/slurm.py.sig_handler: handle SLURM SIGUSR1 signal by logging process info and requeuing the job on the main process
facebookresearch_fid/src/slurm.py.term_handler: handle SIGTERM signal by logging and bypassing termination for graceful SLURM job shutdown
facebookresearch_fid/src/slurm.py.review_init_distributed_mode: review the init_distributed_mode function to understand SLURM multi-node and torch.distributed.launch setup

facebookresearch_fid/src/util.py.save_model_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model with optimizer and scheduler state to a checkpoint directory
facebookresearch_fid/src/util.py.load_model_checkpoint: load a pretrained model with optimizer and scheduler from a saved checkpoint path
facebookresearch_fid/src/util.py.create_warmup_linear_scheduler: create a warmup linear learning rate scheduler with configurable warmup steps and min ratio
facebookresearch_fid/src/util.py.init_logger_distributed: initialize a logging instance with optional file output and distributed training support
facebookresearch_fid/src/util.py.load_passages_from_tsv: load tab-separated passage data from a TSV file into a list of tuples
